summary: Verified responsive fixes on static /tgf/ site. Measured document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth at 360/390/414/620/768/980/1024/1280 px — all match exactly (diff = 0) on both index.html and mentions-legales.html. No horizontal document-level overflow. Burger menu, mobile nav, announcement bar, and France map all behave correctly at mobile widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Several decorative elements (hero IMG, #marquee, striped side bands) extend past the viewport but are correctly clipped by ancestor overflow:hidden wrappers — this is expected and does not cause document-level horizontal scroll.
Consider adding max-width:100% + object-fit on the hero IMG to avoid negative-left bleed on very small widths if the design later removes the clipping wrapper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served at /tgf/index.html and /tgf/mentions-legales.html. Responsiveness verified across 8 breakpoints (360-1280). Burger (#burger) correctly opens #mobileNav under 980px and closes on link click. Announcement bar stays single-line (height 36px, white-space nowrap, overflow hidden). France map (#mapwrap) fits inside viewport at 360px (49-311 of 360) with 28 pins. Negative-left offenders reported by brute-force DOM scan are inside overflow:hidden parents (marquee, hero image, striped bands) and are harmless — document scrollWidth equals innerWidth at every tested width.

verification_measurements.burger_menu: visible at 360px, opens #mobileNav, closes after link click
